name: neuropathic pain overview
title: Neuropathic pain has a neurological cause and is recognized by its descriptors; after the cause is evaluated, one agent is chosen by the co-existing problem (amitriptyline for poor sleep or low cost, duloxetine for depression, carbamazepine for trigeminal neuralgia, gabapentinoids, topicals) with narcotics only as a last resort, and titrated by trial and error

root.title: NEUROPATHIC pain: a neurological cause, peripheral or central
lines: sounds like: electrical · shooting · burning, hot or cold · pins and needles
allodynia: a non-painful touch hurts · hyperpathia: a painful stimulus hurts far too much · dysesthesia: uncomfortable sensations (burning)
EVALUATE THE CAUSE and examine: some are reversible · nociceptive pain (tissue injury) takes acetaminophen, NSAIDs, opioids instead

groups.title: ANTIDEPRESSANTS
lines: ↑ norepinephrine and serotonin → stronger descending pain inhibition

groups.title: ANTICONVULSANTS
lines: in specific situations a sodium-channel drug

rows: TRIAL AND ERROR: one agent, titrated up SLOWLY to the maximum dose
1 month at the highest dose, no effect?
